title: Thickness.
officialText:
Projecting signs shall be limited in thickness as provided for in Table H112.6.
TABLE H112.6
THICKNESS OF PROJECTING SIGNS
PROJECTION MAXIMUM THICKNESS
(feet) (feet)

4 2.5
3 3
2 3.5
1 4
